Barcode Camera third-party assets

zxing-wasm 3.1.6 by Ze-Zheng Wu: https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm
JavaScript wrapper: MIT (ZXING-WASM-LICENSE.txt).
C++ bindings: Apache-2.0 (ZXING-WASM-CPP-LICENSE.txt).
Reader engine ZXing-C++: Apache-2.0 (ZXING-CPP-LICENSE.txt).
Reader-only build; no Zint writer is included.

Public Sans Variable 5.3.0 via Fontsource: https://github.com/uswds/public-sans
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (PUBLIC-SANS-LICENSE.txt).

All executable assets and font files are bundled locally. No runtime CDN dependency.
